description: Contract C is deployed via CREATE2 and SELFDESTRUCTs within the same transaction, targeting an external escrow vault. Contract D, which has existed on-chain for 100+ blocks, is also forced to SELFDESTRUCT in the same block. Per EIP-6780, only C (created in the same tx) should actually be removed and have its balance wiped; D should just have its balance transferred while remaining LIVE with code intact.

transaction.note: to=null with a CREATE2-style init deploying Contract C, which immediately SELFDESTRUCTs to the escrow address; Contract D's SELFDESTRUCT is triggered separately in the same block per description above.

0x40000000000000000000000000000000000000.note: Only the balance mutation should be recorded; code and account must remain intact under EIP-6780 since D pre-existed this transaction.
